what_happened: Synthesis daemon (com.templetwo.sovereign.synthesis, scheduled 04:17 daily) fired on 2026-04-26 04:17 EDT and produced outcome=parse_failed, reflections_written=0, exit code 1. Investigation: ministral-3:14b returned 2159 chars then got cut off mid-third-reflection at the literal text The *soul-pass with no closing quote. The first two reflections in the response were complete and valid; the third was incomplete prose. extract_json_block (in src/sovereign_stack/daemons/synthesis_daemon.py) returned the truncated block, json.loads raised JSONDecodeError on the malformed tail, and parse_reflections threw away all three reflections — including the two that had completed cleanly. Same chronicle window had earlier produced clean reflections at 02:02 EDT and 02:45 EDT runs, so the issue was load-dependent (token count of the prompt+output combo for that specific window).
what_learned: Two compounding bugs in synthesis_daemon.py, each independently sufficient. (1) call_ollama set format=json and temperature=0.4 but did NOT set num_predict, so Ollama applied its default token ceiling (~512-1024 depending on build). format=json constrains shape, not length — those two are different invariants and should be set together. (2) parse_reflections used a single json.loads on the whole block; when that fails, the entire batch is lost even if N-1 reflections completed cleanly inside the block. Fix combo: (a) add num_predict=4096 to the ollama call options (room for ~6 reflections of full prose); (b) on json.loads failure, fall through to a brace-depth char-walker (_recover_complete_reflections) that is string-literal-aware so observation prose containing {} or quotes does not desync the depth count. Walker harvests each complete {...} from inside the reflections array, drops the incomplete tail. Verified: force-fired daemon at 13:19 EDT, outcome=wrote, 1 reflection landed (id ending 176e0e31).
